options.name: Contract Matrix Hardening
options.investment: 1-2 weeks; add/expand cross-package parity contract tests and ownership docs.
options.impact: Reduces recurrence of attribution, DI, transition, and interface parity regressions.
options.risk: If deferred, drift continues across runner/provider/retro seams with high rework.

options.name: Failure Signature Taxonomy
options.investment: 3-5 days; add typed failure signatures and dashboards.
options.impact: Improves decomposition timing and avoids repeated blind retries.
options.risk: If classification is too coarse, teams may over-decompose.

options.name: Runner Interface Compatibility Gate
options.investment: 2-3 days; compile-gate suite + adapter parity checks.
options.impact: Catches signature drift before merge and reduces red-build churn.
options.risk: Without it, context/signature changes will keep breaking downstream packages.

options.name: Stage Boundary Debt Burn-down
options.investment: 1 week; remove residual mutable cross-stage side effects and enforce typed outputs.
options.impact: Stabilizes orchestration behavior and improves test determinism.
options.risk: Deferred cleanup increases hidden coupling in future stage changes.

options.name: Subprocess Lifecycle Compliance Sweep
options.investment: 2-4 days; codemod + tests for full procutil lifecycle.
options.impact: Eliminates lingering subprocess safety divergence and cancellation leaks.
options.risk: If skipped, remaining legacy callsites stay fragile under cancellation/load.

options.name: Emission Error Visibility Standard
options.investment: 1-2 days; enforce non-silent capture/emitter failure logging.
options.impact: Improves operational debugging for pipeline/metrics issues.
options.risk: Silent metric loss continues, reducing trust in observability.

options.name: Transition Ledger Verifier
options.investment: 3-5 days; add invariant checker over queue snapshots and transitions.
options.impact: Detects invalid transitions and missing persistence immediately.
options.risk: Without it, queue state corruption remains latent until coordinator stalls.

options.name: Recovery Path Parity Tests
options.investment: 2-3 days; table-driven tests for recovery transitions and persistence.
options.impact: Prevents divergence between normal-path and recovery-path state behavior.
options.risk: Deferred parity keeps reopening old failure modes during incident handling.
